thread:
cara_pm: Heads up — we need a concrete playbook for the 'orchestration surge' rollout next week. Customer pilot + expected EU lunch surge. Want feature flags, A/B sampling, regional slices, and a fast kill/fallback plan. who wants to pair on the checklist?
ben_eng: I can draft canary phases. thinking 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% w/ 30m evaluation windows. include cost cap per-tenant and latency SLO checks.
drew_sre: add an autoshed policy: if p95 > 350ms or error rate > 0.8% for 5 minutes, auto-scale fallback and notify. fallback should reroute to quantized v1 or smaller model variant.
ellen_data: we should measure quality drift during A/B: sample 2% of requests to shadow full-quality model and run quick evals on core prompts. if ROUGE/LL drop > X then rollback.
alice_p: agree. also require a guardrail header to mark experimental traffic: X-Redwood-Release: orchestration-surge. makes tracing easier in console.
ben_eng: here's a small feature flag payload proposal — use this for ramp automation:
```json
{
  "flag": "orchestration.surge.v1",
  "phases": [
    {"name": "canary1", "percent": 1, "duration_minutes": 30, "region": "us-west"},
    {"name": "canary2", "percent": 5, "duration_minutes": 60, "region": "eu-central"},
    {"name": "scaleup", "percent": 20, "duration_minutes": 60, "region": "eu-central,us-east"},
    {"name": "wide", "percent": 60, "duration_minutes": 120, "region": "global"}
  ],
  "auto_rollback": {
    "conditions": [
      {"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "threshold": 350, "window_minutes": 5},
      {"metric": "error_rate", "threshold": 0.8, "window_minutes": 5}
    ],
    "fallback": "model:open-quantized-v1"
  }
}
```
drew_sre: love it. add a hard kill-switch: if total token spend per-minute > 1.5x baseline for >10min, flip to regional rate-limiter and restrict non-whitelisted tenants.
ellen_data: sample keys for quality checks: 200 eval prompts, prioritize customer-critical prompts + top-traffic intents. run nightly regression and daily quick checks during rollout.
alice_p: ops checklist items: prewarm KV-cache for quantized variant in target regions, populate model variants in routing table, set alert runbook link, and schedule on-call rota for first 6 hours.
cara_pm: good. can we do an A/B assignment that balances token-cost? want to avoid skewing high-token users into the experiment cohort. maybe weight sampling by recent 7-day token usage.
ben_eng: yes — flag service supports weighted sampling. config: weight = max(1, floor(1 + 10 * (avg_tokens / global_median))). that reduces heavy-user exposure.
deploy-bot: deployment triggered: rollout orchestration-surge.v1 -> canary1 at 1977777800 by ben_eng. status: IN_PROGRESS. :rocket:
alice_p: on-call note: make sure the console dashboard surfaces per-flag cost and p95 side-by-side. if we see cost delta > 20% vs baseline, hit kill switch.
drew_sre: will add an ephemeral route: /internal/ops/orchestration-surge/kill that executes immediate fallback and posts to #incidents. Test it now?
cara_pm: yes, test now with dry-run. ensure logs include X-Redwood-Release header so we can slice.
ben_eng: tested dry-run -> route flagged traffic to fallback, logs show header, KV prewarm triggered. all good.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary1 reached 1% at 1977777820. monitoring hooks live.
cara_pm: thanks team — I'll add runbook to the playbook doc and share with sales/customer success. post any additions here. :pray:
